If {{company}} is starting to connect agents to internal systems, the two Qlaas layers below are how we do it: one defines what an agent may touch, the other coordinates the work and checks the result.

Qlaas DMI: Define the actions an agent can request, the records it can access and when its permission expires.

Qlaas Services: Route requests between people and systems. Track approvals and match the result to the original case.
